statement: Dolphin pinned ControllerInterface hardware-input initialization includes mapped extension identity, downstream F6, MP calibration A40020/32 and optional downstream calibration A40040/16 without F7 polling, F1 write or challenge data request in that host-side state machine. Dolphin Real Wii Remote mode delivers native register commands between the emulated console/game and device instead of invoking the ControllerInterface decoder. A game's challenge polling/rejection outcome therefore cannot be inferred from successful Dolphin ControllerInterface gyroscope observation or its absence.
